title: Audi has a new flagship designed with the US in mind: The 2027 Q9
summary: Audi has unveiled the 2027 Q9, a new full-size flagship SUV designed specifically for the US market, priced starting at $87,700. The vehicle will launch in Q4 2026, positioning Audi to compete in the premium large SUV segment.
content: The new full-size flagship SUV starts at $87,700 when it goes on sale in Q4.

zh.title: 奥迪推出为美国市场设计的新旗舰车型：2027 Q9
zh.summary: 奥迪推出了2027 Q9，这是一款专为美国市场设计的全尺寸旗舰SUV，起价为87,700美元。该车将于2026年第四季度推出，定位奥迪在高端大型SUV市场的竞争力。

title: Cyera agrees to acquire Oasis Security for $1B to safeguard proliferating AI agents
summary: Cyera is acquiring Oasis Security for $1 billion to address security needs for AI agents. This is the third acquisition Cyera has made this year.
content: The deal is Cyera's third acquisition this year.

zh.title: Cyera同意以10亿美元收购Oasis Security以保护激增的AI代理
zh.summary: Cyera以10亿美元收购Oasis Security来解决AI代理的安全需求。这是Cyera今年进行的第三次收购。
